She wears an everyday muted rust-red cotton sari, simple blouse, hair loosely tied, no ornate jewellery. Faces only hinted with a few drawing marks, no identifiable real person or actor likeness. Use spare ink linework with flat muted terracotta and olive-grey gouache areas, clean light paper, selective detail and believable hands, seated weight and fabric folds. Strong composition from above gives the script discussion visual importance; asymmetrical ordinary space and no decorative props. Do not recreate any film scene or a documented meeting. No text or readable script, logos, film posters, trophies, laptops, faux age, photographic effects, spotlight, film reels, window-glow, idyllic veranda or decorative plants. The feeling is someone involved in shaping a story, an ordinary working exchange. Landscape full scene and keep central gestures clear for a preview card.
